pages.title: Catwoman Holding Her Coiled Whip on a Gotham City Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman stands on a Gotham rooftop in this printable coloring page, holding her coiled whip beside a winged gargoyle beneath the Bat-signal. Her cat-eared cowl, goggle frames, utility belt, and tall boots create smaller sections within the bold figure, while the skyline leaves open areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Leaping Across a Narrow Gap Between Gotham Rooftops Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman leaping between Gotham rooftops, with goggles above her eyes and a coiled whip hanging from her belt. Her outstretched arms and bent knee emphasize the jump, while brickwork, a crescent moon, and a small rooftop gargoyle add distinct details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Climbing a Brick Wall with Her Clawed Gloves Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman climbs a brick wall with clawed gloves in this printable coloring page, turning toward the viewer with one knee raised against the masonry. Her goggles and coiled whip stand out against repeated brick shapes, giving the coloring sheet broad costume areas and many smaller sections along the cracked wall.

pages.title: Catwoman Swinging From a Rooftop Cornice with Her Whip Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman swings from a rooftop cornice in this printable coloring page, gripping her whip above her head with one arm stretched outward for balance. The looping cord, curved architectural bracket, and crescent moon frame her diagonal pose, while clear costume outlines leave broad spaces across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Stepping Through a Museum Security Laser Grid Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Catwoman stepping through a museum security laser grid, with a raised knee, poised hands, and goggles above her mask. Crossing beams divide the room into narrow shapes around her, while cameras, framed displays, and a diamond on a pedestal add precise details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Opening a Jewelry Store Safe Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman kneels beside an opening jewelry store safe in this printable coloring page, turning its combination dial as necklaces and gemstones appear on the shelves. The thick door, long handle, and rows of rivets surround her crouching pose, adding smaller mechanical and jewelry details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Lifting a Diamond Necklace From an Open Museum Display Case Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman lifting a diamond necklace from an open museum display case, with one gloved hand resting on its frame. The necklace's round beads and faceted pendant contrast with her broad catsuit panels, while the raised glass lid creates large angular spaces on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Cutting a Circular Opening in a Museum Window with Her Claws Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman cuts a circular opening in a museum window with her claws in this printable coloring page, standing beside a displayed diamond and classical statue. Long glove claws, buckled boots, and the coiled whip at her hip add fine outlines, while the tiled floor provides geometric sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Crawling Through a Museum Ventilation Duct Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman crawls through a museum ventilation duct in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside an open grille with her goggles perched on her cat-eared cowl. Riveted wall panels surround her, and the small opening reveals a framed portrait and pedestal, giving the coloring sheet a mix of broad panels and close details.

pages.title: Catwoman Descending a Gotham Fire Escape with a Jewel Pouch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman descending a Gotham fire escape with a jewel pouch, gripping the railing beside an apartment window and brick wall. A gemstone peeks from the gathered bag, while the diagonal stair rails and repeated vertical bars create narrow geometric sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Hiding Behind a Rooftop Chimney as a Police Helicopter Passes Overhead Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman hides behind a rooftop chimney in this printable coloring page as a police helicopter passes overhead, its searchlight reaching across the night sky. Her crouched pose sits below the chimney's brick cap, with a crescent moon and vent pipe adding simple outlined details around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Studying a Museum Floor Plan at Her Apartment Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman studying a museum floor plan at her apartment desk, pointing at a room while holding a large magnifying glass. A desk lamp, notebook, pencil cup, and tiny cat figure surround the plan, while a moonlit window and bookshelf complete the detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Balancing on a Steel Beam Above a Gotham Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman balances on a steel beam above a Gotham alley in this printable coloring page, crouching with arms extended and her whip coiled at her hip. The beam's exposed end and rivets contrast with the fire escape behind her, while a crescent moon and angular skyline frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Rescuing a Kitten From a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman reaches toward a kitten in a tree in this printable coloring page, offering both gloved hands beneath its paws while sitting against the trunk. The kitten's curled tail, small leaves, and Catwoman's raised goggles provide compact details, with larger open areas across her costume and the trunk on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Feeding a Stray Cat Outside Her Gotham Apartment Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman feeding a stray cat outside her Gotham apartment, kneeling with a food bowl as the cat raises one paw. Her goggles, tall boots, and zipped catsuit sit against a sparse brick wall, with a window, ladder, and trash can adding structure to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Selina Kyle Removing Her Catwoman Cowl in Front of an Apartment Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: Selina Kyle removes her Catwoman cowl before an apartment mirror in this printable coloring page, revealing short wavy hair above her fitted zippered catsuit. The full-length reflection repeats her raised arms, utility belt, and tall boots, while a potted plant, sofa, and floorboards add interior details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Returning a Stolen Necklace to a Museum Guard Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman returns a stolen necklace to a museum guard in this printable coloring page, holding its large pendant above his outstretched hands beside an empty display. Her cat-eared cowl and the guard's peaked cap frame their exchange, while a statue, rope barriers, and tiled floor add clear outlines to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Blocking a Jewel Thief's Escape with Her Whip Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman blocking a jewel thief's escape with her whip, wrapping it around his torso as he clutches a bulging bag. Gemstones and a beaded necklace protrude from the pouch, while the thief's striped hat, Catwoman's goggles, and rooftop masonry supply smaller details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman and Batman Meeting Beside the Bat-signal on a Gotham Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman and Batman meet beside the Bat-signal on a Gotham rooftop in this printable coloring page, facing each other beneath a crescent moon and clouds. Batman's chest emblem and utility belt contrast with Catwoman's goggles and zippered suit, while the circular searchlight creates a large central shape on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman and Batman Chasing a Jewel Thief Through a Gotham Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman and Batman chasing a jewel thief through a Gotham alley, with loose gemstones spilling behind his overfilled shoulder bag. Batman's wide cape spreads across the scene, while Catwoman follows beside brick walls, a fire escape, and trash containers that add angular sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Catwoman Handing a Recovered Diamond to Robin on a Gotham Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman hands a recovered diamond to Robin on a Gotham rooftop in this printable coloring page, presenting the large faceted stone toward his open hand. pages.title: Catwoman and Batgirl Examining a Broken Museum Display Case Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman and Batgirl examine a broken museum display case in this printable coloring page, with Batgirl pointing toward shattered glass while Catwoman holds her chin. pages.description: This printable coloring page places Catwoman opposite the Joker inside an abandoned theater, where she gestures toward him beside a damaged stage and torn curtains. pages.title: Catwoman and Harley Quinn Escaping a Gotham Bank Vault Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman and Harley Quinn escape a Gotham bank vault in this printable coloring page, running with tied bags while Harley carries a large raised mallet. pages.title: Catwoman and Poison Ivy Sheltering a Stray Cat in a Gotham Greenhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman and Poison Ivy shelter a stray cat in a Gotham greenhouse in this printable coloring page, crouching together as Ivy cradles the sleeping animal. pages.title: Catwoman, Harley Quinn and Poison Ivy by a Door Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman with Harley Quinn and Poison Ivy outside their Gotham City Sirens hideout, standing before a vine-covered pointed doorway. pages.title: Classic Catwoman Wearing Her Purple Dress and Green Cape Beside a Stone Gargoyle Coloring Page
pages.description: Classic Catwoman stands beside a stone gargoyle in this printable coloring page, resting one hand on its horned head while wearing a long dress and cape. pages.title: Catwoman Crouching Beside an Open Skylight Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features 1990s Catwoman crouching beside an open museum skylight, with long gloves, flowing curls, and her whip looped at her hip. pages.title: Batman Year One Catwoman Wearing Her Whiskered Cowl on a Gotham Fire Escape Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman from Batman Year One crouches on a Gotham fire escape in this printable coloring page, wearing a whiskered cowl and a pouch-lined utility belt. pages.title: Batman Returns Catwoman Swinging Her Whip Inside Shreck's Department Store Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catwoman from Batman Returns swinging her whip inside Shreck's department store, with her stitched cowl facing forward beneath the looping cord. pages.title: The Dark Knight Rises Catwoman Riding the Bat-pod Through Gotham City Coloring Page

pages.title: The Batman Catwoman Removing Her Motorcycle Helmet Beside Her Parked Bike Coloring Page
pages.description: Catwoman from The Batman removes her motorcycle helmet beside her parked bike in this printable coloring page, revealing cropped hair above her fitted riding suit. pages.title: The Batman Catwoman Riding Alongside Batman Through a Gotham Cemetery Coloring Page
